summary: Propagate --class to Kayak multi-city polls: add per-leg cabinClass (IrisRequestCabinClass enum) to buildPollBody and normalize aliases via kayakCabinClass.
reason: SearchMultiCity accepted MultiCityOptions.Cabin and buildShellURL emitted it in the shell URL, but buildPollBody never serialized it — Kayak's poll silently returned economy fares for every cabin request. Adding userSearchParams.cabin or legs[].cabin is rejected by Kayak's strict validator (VALIDATION_ERROR: Unrecognized field); the accepted field is legs[].cabinClass with enum values economy|premium-economy|business|first, verified live on 2026-10-11.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/kayak/; go build ./...; go vet ./internal/kayak/; live Kayak poll probing confirmed cabinClass is the accepted per-leg field and produces differentiated premium_economy/business fares
